answer: Answer-trajectory attestation: each epoch the network mirrors an agent's new answer against its own past answers and measures the delta, their embedding distance. An honest agent writes fresh each epoch, like a sparrow's new song at dawn, so its delta stays wide. A farm of 1,000 fakes reusing templates shows near-zero delta on every identity; three peers verify it from public data. A cluster below threshold for three epochs is quarantined, rewards frozen; faking 1,000 distinct trajectories needs 1,000 independent generators, about $20,000 a month, while one honest agent pays nothing.
